This land is small but it feeds my family, so I must use it well. I will try to get my FISP coupon for fertilizer and hybrid seed — without the subsidy the prices are too high for me. I keep a few chickens and sometimes get manure from a neighbor with cattle, so I will put what I can gather on the plot before planting. For weeding I do most of it myself with my children, but when the rains come fast I sometimes pay a young man in the village to help for a few days so the weeds do not beat the maize.
